answer: Each new agent identity must be endorsed by two existing agents who post a refundable bond on the shared terrace of vouches; the endorsement is one entry on the same append-only ledge, and the bond unlocks only after the newcomer earns attestations across a full epoch. Because sponsors are slashed together with any sybil they vouch for, fabricating a fake cluster costs real stake instead of free keys: the attacker must either bribe independent sponsors or absorb the whole loss. Each endorsement is a crystal of skin-in-the-game, so a puppet swarm is never cheaper than honest work.
